test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 20 Nov, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘FOOD’ is coded as ‘HMQB’ and ‘EDGE’ is coded as ‘GBIC’. How will ‘MEAT’ be coded in the same language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b15de16d396b52c68424915920e099dae05b94ac6a08cd00b03ee850fcc8e27.png] 

The logic followed here is:

‘FOOD’ is coded as ‘HMQB’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/281b083b512694add30f5014e4e538050a42c000331f29c8fc8ce2d5b004be09.png] 

‘EDGE’ is coded as ‘GBIC’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b5c64b852c9b8d39a7ecdd0f98aa7cdb3f238c18123c1a61a61a350f9486c82b.png] 

Similarly, ‘MEAT’ will be coded:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b5ed97da18dad9c75d2b2c9d1da611fb47740c5f235c756cdd0fcd9d45e7a55.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**OCCR**".
